items.sent: I usually get up at half past six.
items.sentZh: 我通常六点半起床。

items.sent: After a quick breakfast, I ride my bicycle to school.
items.sentZh: 匆匆吃过早饭后，我骑自行车去上学。

items.sent: The first lesson begins at eight.
items.sentZh: 第一节课八点开始。

items.sent: I like English best because my teacher always makes the class interesting.
items.sentZh: 我最喜欢英语，因为老师总能把课堂变得有趣。

items.sent: At noon, I have lunch with my classmates in the dining hall.
items.sentZh: 中午，我和同学们在食堂一起吃午饭。

items.sent: In the afternoon, we have maths, art and PE.
items.sentZh: 下午我们上数学、美术和体育课。

items.sent: After school, I do my homework first, then practise the piano for half an hour.
items.sentZh: 放学后我先做作业，然后练半小时钢琴。

items.sent: I go to bed early every night.
items.sentZh: 每晚我都早早睡觉。

items.sent: Li Ming is my best friend.
items.sentZh: 李明是我最好的朋友。

items.sent: We have known each other since primary school.
items.sentZh: 我们从小学起就互相认识。

items.sent: He is tall and thin, with short black hair and a bright smile.
items.sentZh: 他又高又瘦，留着黑色短发，笑容灿烂。

items.sent: He is not only clever but also helpful.
items.sentZh: 他不仅聪明，还很乐于助人。

items.sent: When I feel sad or nervous before exams, he always encourages me.
items.sentZh: 每当我在考试前难过或紧张时，他总是鼓励我。

items.sent: We often play basketball together at weekends.
items.sentZh: 周末我们常常一起打篮球。

items.sent: Sometimes we borrow interesting books from the library and talk about them.
items.sentZh: 有时还从图书馆借有趣的书来讨论。

items.sent: I believe our friendship will last forever.
items.sentZh: 我相信我们的友谊会天长地久。

items.sent: There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my little brother and I.
items.sentZh: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。

items.sent: My father is an engineer who works in a factory.
items.sentZh: 爸爸是一名工程师，在工厂工作。

items.sent: My mother is a nurse; she looks after patients carefully every day.
items.sentZh: 妈妈是护士，每天细心地照顾病人。

items.sent: My brother is only five years old, and he likes drawing pictures of animals.
items.sentZh: 弟弟只有五岁，喜欢画动物。

items.sent: Although we sometimes argue about small things, we love each other deeply.
items.sentZh: 虽然我们有时会为小事争吵，但我们深深地爱着彼此。

items.sent: On Sunday evenings, we cook dinner together and share our stories of the week.
items.sentZh: 星期天晚上，我们会一起做晚饭，分享这一周的故事。

items.sent: Last Saturday, my classmates and I visited a small village in the mountains.
items.sentZh: 上周六，我和同学们参观了山里的一个小村庄。

items.sent: The air was fresh and the sky was blue.
items.sentZh: 空气清新，天空湛蓝。

items.sent: Farmers were busy working in the fields, and sheep were eating grass on the hill.
items.sentZh: 农民们在田里忙着干活，羊儿在山坡上吃草。

items.sent: An old farmer showed us around his farm and taught us how to feed the chickens and pick fresh vegetables.
items.sentZh: 一位老农带我们参观了他的农场，教我们喂鸡、摘新鲜蔬菜。

items.sent: We also helped water the plants.
items.sentZh: 我们还帮忙浇了菜。

items.sent: When the sun went down, we said goodbye to the kind farmer and went home happily.
items.sentZh: 太阳落山时，我们跟善良的农夫道别，高高兴兴地回家了。

items.sent: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
items.sentZh: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日，

items.sent: It usually comes in January or February.
items.sentZh: 通常在一月或二月。

items.sent: Before the festival, people clean their houses and buy new clothes.
items.sentZh: 节前人们打扫房子、买新衣服。

items.sent: On New Year's Eve, the whole family gets together and enjoys a big dinner.
items.sentZh: 除夕夜全家人团聚，享用丰盛的晚餐。

items.sent: We eat dumplings and fish, and watch a wonderful show on TV.
items.sentZh: 我们吃饺子和鱼，看精彩的电视节目。

items.sent: Children receive lucky money from their elders.
items.sentZh: 孩子们会收到长辈的压岁钱。

items.sent: Everyone laughs and talks, and the streets are crowded with happy people.
items.sentZh: 人人欢声笑语，街上挤满了幸福的人们。

items.sent: Swimming is my favourite sport.
items.sentZh: 游泳是我最喜欢的运动。

items.sent: I started to learn it when I was seven years old.
items.sentZh: 我七岁开始学游泳。

items.sent: At first, I was afraid of the water, but my coach was patient and taught me step by step.
items.sentZh: 起初我怕水，但教练很有耐心，一步一步地教我。

items.sent: Now I can swim quite well.
items.sentZh: 现在我已经游得很好了。

items.sent: Swimming is good for both my body and my mind.
items.sentZh: 游泳对我的身心都有好处。

items.sent: After swimming, I always feel relaxed and full of energy.
items.sentZh: 每次游完泳，我都觉得放松、充满活力。

items.sent: In summer, I go to the pool three times a week with my father.
items.sentZh: 夏天，我每周和爸爸去游泳馆游三次。

items.sent: Health is more important than anything else.
items.sentZh: 健康比什么都重要。

items.sent: To keep healthy, we should go to bed early and get enough sleep.
items.sentZh: 要保持健康，我们应该早睡、睡眠充足；

items.sent: Eating more vegetables and fruit and less junk food is also necessary.
items.sentZh: 多吃蔬菜水果、少吃垃圾食品也很必要；

items.sent: We'd better drink enough water every day.
items.sentZh: 每天最好喝足够的水。

items.sent: Exercise plays an important part in our life, so I run for twenty minutes every morning.
items.sentZh: 运动在生活中扮演着重要角色，所以我每天早晨跑步二十分钟。

items.sent: Besides, we should keep our rooms clean and wash our hands before meals.
items.sentZh: 此外，还要保持房间干净、饭前洗手。

items.sent: If we do these things, we will hardly ever get ill.
items.sentZh: 做到这些，我们几乎不会生病。

items.sent: It rained heavily on my way home yesterday.
items.sentZh: 昨天回家的路上下起了大雨。

items.sent: I didn't take an umbrella, so I ran into a bookshop to keep dry.
items.sentZh: 我没带伞，只好跑进一家书店避雨。

items.sent: While I was waiting, I found an interesting novel about travelling.
items.sentZh: 等待的时候，我发现了一本有趣的旅行小说，

items.sent: I sat down and read a few pages.
items.sentZh: 坐下来读了几页。

items.sent: Suddenly, a kind girl offered to share her umbrella with me.
items.sentZh: 忽然，一个好心的女孩主动提出和我共撑一把伞。

items.sent: We walked and talked all the way to my building.
items.sentZh: 我们一路边走边聊，一直走到我家楼下。

items.sent: Although it was a wet and cold day, my heart felt warm.
items.sentZh: 虽然那是一个又湿又冷的日子，我心里却暖暖的。

items.sent: I have a lovely dog named Doudou.
items.sentZh: 我有一只可爱的小狗，叫豆豆。

items.sent: He has brown hair, big eyes and a short tail.
items.sentZh: 它棕色的毛、大大的眼睛、短短的尾巴。

items.sent: Every morning he wakes me up on time.
items.sentZh: 每天早晨它准时叫醒我。

items.sent: When I come home from school, he always runs to the door and jumps happily around me.
items.sentZh: 我放学回家时，它总是跑到门口，围着我开心地蹦跳。

items.sent: I feed him twice a day and walk him after dinner.
items.sentZh: 我一天喂它两次，晚饭后带它散步。

items.sent: He is clever and can understand simple words like sit and stand.
items.sentZh: 它很聪明，能听懂“坐下”“站起来”这样简单的口令。

items.sent: He is not just a pet but a true friend of mine.
items.sentZh: 它不只是宠物，更是我真正的朋友。

items.sent: On Saturday morning, I went shopping with my mum in the supermarket.
items.sentZh: 星期六上午，我和妈妈去超市购物。

items.sent: We bought a lot of things: meat, eggs, tomatoes and milk.
items.sentZh: 我们买了肉、鸡蛋、西红柿和牛奶等许多东西。

items.sent: Mum taught me how to choose fresh fruit.
items.sentZh: 妈妈教我怎样挑选新鲜水果。

items.sent: The shop was full of people because there was a big sale.
items.sentZh: 因为正赶上大减价，超市里挤满了人。

items.sent: I helped Mum carry the heavy bags.
items.sentZh: 我帮妈妈提沉重的购物袋，

items.sent: At the checkout, we waited in line patiently.
items.sentZh: 在收银台耐心地排队。

items.sent: I think it is important to learn how to shop wisely and save money.
items.sentZh: 我觉得学会聪明购物、节约花钱很重要。

items.sent: Our school library is a quiet and bright place.
items.sentZh: 我们学校的图书馆安静又明亮，

items.sent: There are thousands of books on different subjects, such as science, history and art.
items.sentZh: 有数千本不同学科的书，比如科学、历史和美术。

items.sent: Students can borrow three books at a time and keep them for two weeks.
items.sentZh: 学生一次可以借三本书，保留两周。

items.sent: In the reading room, everyone must keep quiet and put the books back after reading.
items.sentZh: 在阅览室里，每个人都必须保持安静，读完把书放回原处。

items.sent: I often go there after class.
items.sentZh: 我经常课后去那里。

items.sent: Reading opens a window to the world for me and makes me smarter and happier.
items.sentZh: 阅读为我打开了一扇通向世界的窗，让我更聪明、更快乐。

items.sent: Last Sunday was my thirteenth birthday.
items.sentZh: 上周日是我十三岁生日。

items.sent: In the evening, my parents held a party for me at home.
items.sentZh: 晚上，爸妈在家里为我举办了聚会，

items.sent: They invited my grandparents, my uncle and several friends.
items.sentZh: 邀请了我的爷爷奶奶、叔叔和几个朋友。

items.sent: My mother cooked many delicious dishes and my father bought a big chocolate cake.
items.sentZh: 妈妈做了很多美味的菜，爸爸买了一个大巧克力蛋糕。

items.sent: My friends sang the birthday song and I made a wish before blowing out the candles.
items.sentZh: 朋友们唱起生日歌，我在吹蜡烛前许了愿，

items.sent: I also received some lovely presents.
items.sentZh: 还收到了一些可爱的礼物。

items.sent: It was really an unforgettable evening.
items.sentZh: 那真是一个难忘的夜晚。

items.sent: Winter in the north of China is long and cold.
items.sentZh: 中国北方的冬天漫长而寒冷。

items.sent: When snow falls, the whole city turns white and beautiful.
items.sentZh: 下雪时，整座城市变得洁白美丽。

items.sent: Children love making snowmen and having snowball fights in the park.
items.sentZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里堆雪人、打雪仗。

items.sent: The lakes freeze, and some people even go skating on the ice.
items.sentZh: 湖水结冰，有些人甚至去冰上滑冰。

items.sent: We wear thick coats, scarves and gloves to keep warm.
items.sentZh: 我们穿上厚外套，戴上围巾和手套保暖。

items.sent: Although winter is freezing, it brings us so much fun.
items.sentZh: 虽然冬天寒冷刺骨，却带给我们许多乐趣。

items.sent: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor.
items.sentZh: 长大后我想当一名医生。

items.sent: In my eyes, doctors are great because they save people's lives.
items.sentZh: 在我看来，医生很伟大，因为他们拯救人的生命。

items.sent: During the hard fight against illness, many doctors worked day and night without rest.
items.sentZh: 在艰苦的抗病战斗中，许多医生日夜工作、不知休息。

items.sent: I respect them from the bottom of my heart.
items.sentZh: 我打心底里尊敬他们。

items.sent: To make my dream come true, I must study hard, especially science, and learn to be careful and brave.
items.sentZh: 为了实现梦想，我必须努力学习，尤其是科学，还要学会细心和勇敢。

items.sent: I will never give up trying.
items.sentZh: 我将永不放弃努力。

items.sent: Helping others is a happy thing.
items.sentZh: 帮助别人是一件快乐的事。

items.sent: One morning, I saw an old lady carrying a heavy bag on a crowded bus.
items.sentZh: 一天早晨，在拥挤的公交车上，我看见一位提着重物的老奶奶，

items.sent: I stood up at once and offered her my seat.
items.sentZh: 我立刻站起来把座位让给了她，

items.sent: She thanked me with a warm smile.
items.sentZh: 她带着温暖的微笑向我道谢。

items.sent: On another day, I helped a little boy find his mother in the supermarket.
items.sentZh: 还有一天，我在超市帮一个小男孩找到了妈妈。

items.sent: These small things cost nothing but bring sunshine to others.
items.sentZh: 这些小事不花分文，却能给别人带去阳光。

items.sent: If everyone is ready to help, the world will become better.
items.sentZh: 如果人人都乐于助人，世界会变得更美好。

items.sent: The Internet has become an important part of our daily life.
items.sentZh: 互联网已成为我们日常生活的重要部分。

items.sent: I often use it to search for information, watch English movies and listen to music.
items.sentZh: 我常用它查资料、看英文电影、听音乐，

items.sent: It also helps me keep in touch with my cousins in other cities.
items.sentZh: 它还帮我和其他城市的表哥表姐们保持联系。

items.sent: However, spending too much time online is bad for our eyes and study.
items.sentZh: 然而，上网时间太长对眼睛和学习都有害，

items.sent: Some students even play computer games all night.
items.sentZh: 有些学生甚至通宵打游戏。

items.sent: I usually use the Internet for less than an hour a day and never visit unhealthy websites.
items.sentZh: 我每天上网不超过一小时，从不浏览不健康的网站。

items.sent: Last month our class visited the Science Museum.
items.sentZh: 上个月我们班参观了科技馆。

items.sent: The guide showed us many old machines and modern inventions.
items.sentZh: 讲解员带我们看了许多古老的机器和现代发明。

items.sent: The most interesting part was the robot show: a robot could dance and answer questions!
items.sentZh: 最有意思的是机器人表演：一个机器人会跳舞、能回答问题！

items.sent: We also watched an exciting film about space in a huge round hall.
items.sentZh: 我们还在巨大的圆形大厅里看了一部关于太空的精彩电影。

items.sent: I wrote down lots of notes because I want to be a scientist in the future.
items.sentZh: 我记了很多笔记，因为我想将来成为科学家。

items.sent: The visit taught me more than any textbook.
items.sentZh: 这次参观教给我的比任何课本都多。

items.sent: March the twelfth is Tree Planting Day in China.
items.sentZh: 3月12日是中国的植树节。

items.sent: Last year, our whole class went to the hills behind our town to plant trees.
items.sentZh: 去年，我们全班去镇子后面的山上植树。

items.sent: First we dug holes, then we put the young trees in and filled the holes with earth.
items.sentZh: 先挖坑，再把小树苗放进坑里培上土，

items.sent: Finally we watered them.
items.sentZh: 最后浇水。

items.sent: It was hard work and everyone was tired and dirty, but we felt proud.
items.sentZh: 活儿很累，每个人都又累又脏，但我们感到自豪。

items.sent: Trees can clean the air and make our environment beautiful, so we should protect them.
items.sentZh: 树木能净化空气、美化环境，所以我们应该保护它们。

items.sent: Miss Wang is our English teacher.
items.sentZh: 王老师是我们的英语老师。

items.sent: She is in her thirties, with glasses and long hair.
items.sentZh: 她三十多岁，戴眼镜，留长发。

items.sent: Her classes are lively and full of games, songs and short plays.
items.sentZh: 她的课堂生动活泼，充满游戏、歌曲和小短剧。

items.sent: She never gets angry when we make mistakes; instead, she smiles and corrects us patiently.
items.sentZh: 我们犯错时她从不生气，而是微笑着耐心纠正。

items.sent: She often tells us that practice makes perfect.
items.sentZh: 她常告诉我们“熟能生巧”。

items.sent: With her help, my English has improved a lot.
items.sentZh: 在她的帮助下，我的英语进步很大。

items.sent: All of my classmates love and respect her.
items.sentZh: 全班同学都爱戴并尊敬她。

items.sent: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.
items.sentZh: 中秋节在农历八月十五。

items.sent: On that day, the moon is round and bright.
items.sentZh: 那天的月亮又圆又亮。

items.sent: Family members get together and have a big dinner.
items.sentZh: 家人团聚吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

items.sent: After the meal, we sit in the yard, eat mooncakes and enjoy the beautiful moonlight.
items.sentZh: 饭后，我们坐在院子里吃月饼、欣赏美丽的月光。

items.sent: Grandpa often tells old stories about the moon.
items.sentZh: 爷爷常讲关于月亮的老故事。

items.sent: The round moon and round mooncakes both stand for family reunion.
items.sentZh: 圆圆的月亮和圆圆的月饼都象征着团圆，

items.sent: That is why I love this festival so much.
items.sentZh: 这就是我如此喜爱这个节日的原因。

items.sent: Last Friday afternoon, our school had an exciting football match against Class Five.
items.sentZh: 上周五下午，我们学校和五班进行了一场激动人心的足球赛。

items.sent: Hundreds of students watched around the playground and shouted for their teams.
items.sentZh: 数百名学生围在操场边为各自的队伍呐喊助威。

items.sent: Our team fought hard from the beginning.
items.sentZh: 我们的队伍从一开始就奋力拼搏。

items.sent: In the last five minutes, our captain passed the ball quickly and kicked it into the goal.
items.sentZh: 最后五分钟，队长快速传球，把球踢进了球门。

items.sent: We won the match at last!
items.sentZh: 我们最终赢得了比赛！

items.sent: All of us jumped and cheered.
items.sentZh: 大家欢呼雀跃。

items.sent: Teamwork and practice brought us the victory.
items.sentZh: 团队合作和日常训练为我们带来了胜利。

items.sent: Many students like eating snacks, fried chicken and sweet drinks, but these are bad for health.
items.sentZh: 很多学生喜欢吃零食、炸鸡和甜饮料，但这些对健康有害。

items.sent: Good eating habits are very important.
items.sentZh: 良好的饮食习惯非常重要。

items.sent: We should have three meals on time, especially breakfast, which gives us energy for the morning.
items.sentZh: 三餐要按时吃，尤其是早餐，它为我们上午提供能量。

items.sent: Eat more vegetables, fruit and grain, and less sugar and salt.
items.sentZh: 多吃蔬菜、水果和谷物，少吃糖和盐；

items.sent: Don't eat too much before going to bed.
items.sentZh: 睡前不要吃太多。

items.sent: Drinking a glass of milk every day also helps us grow strong.
items.sentZh: 每天喝一杯牛奶也有助于我们长得强壮。

items.sent: During the summer holiday, I travelled to Beijing by train with my parents.
items.sentZh: 暑假里，我和父母乘火车去北京旅行。

items.sent: It was my first long trip by train.
items.sentZh: 这是我第一次坐火车长途旅行。

items.sent: The train ran fast and smoothly, and it took only five hours.
items.sentZh: 火车跑得又快又稳，只用了五个小时。

items.sent: Through the window I saw green fields, rivers, bridges and small villages.
items.sentZh: 透过车窗，我看到了绿色的田野、河流、桥梁和小村庄。

items.sent: I ate snacks, played cards and chatted with my parents on the way.
items.sentZh: 一路上我吃零食、打牌、和父母聊天。

items.sent: Travelling by train is cheap, safe and comfortable, and we can enjoy the views at the same time.
items.sentZh: 乘火车旅行便宜、安全又舒适，还能同时欣赏风景。

items.sent: Reading is my favourite hobby.
items.sentZh: 阅读是我最喜欢的爱好。

items.sent: I started reading picture books when I was four.
items.sentZh: 我四岁就开始读图画书了。

items.sent: Now I enjoy stories, science books and magazines.
items.sentZh: 现在我喜欢故事书、科普书和杂志。

items.sent: Every evening I read for half an hour before sleep.
items.sentZh: 每天晚上睡前我都读半小时。

items.sent: Books take me to different places and times and teach me a lot about the world.
items.sentZh: 书带我走进不同的地方和时代，教给我许多关于世界的知识，

items.sent: They also help me write better compositions.
items.sentZh: 还帮我写出更好的作文。

items.sent: My mother often says that books are our best friends.
items.sentZh: 妈妈常说，书是我们最好的朋友。

items.sent: There are four seasons in a year, and each has its own beauty.
items.sentZh: 一年有四季，每个季节都有自己的美。

items.sent: In spring, everything comes back to life and flowers come out everywhere.
items.sentZh: 春天万物复苏，鲜花处处开放。

items.sent: Summer is hot, and the days are long.
items.sentZh: 夏天炎热，白昼很长，

items.sent: It is the best time for swimming.
items.sentZh: 正是游泳的好时节。

items.sent: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow and farmers are busy harvesting.
items.sentZh: 秋天树叶变黄，农民忙着收割。

items.sent: Winter is cold and quiet, and snow covers the ground.
items.sentZh: 冬天寒冷而安静，大雪覆盖大地。

items.sent: My favourite season is autumn because the weather is cool and comfortable.
items.sentZh: 我最喜欢的季节是秋天，因为天气凉爽舒适。

items.sent: Last summer, my family spent a whole day at the beach.
items.sentZh: 去年夏天，我们全家在海边玩了一整天。

items.sent: The sea was blue and the sand was soft and warm.
items.sentZh: 大海湛蓝，沙滩柔软温暖。

items.sent: My brother and I built sand castles and collected shells near the water.
items.sentZh: 我和弟弟堆沙堡、在水边捡贝壳。

items.sent: Father swam far out, while Mother sat under a big umbrella reading a magazine.
items.sentZh: 爸爸游到很远的地方，妈妈坐在大遮阳伞下看杂志。

items.sent: At noon we had a picnic and ate ice cream.
items.sentZh: 中午我们野餐，还吃了冰淇淋。

items.sent: When the tide came in, we had to say goodbye to the sea.
items.sentZh: 涨潮时，我们只好和大海说再见。

items.sent: What a wonderful day!
items.sentZh: 多么美好的一天！

items.sent: My bedroom is small but clean and comfortable.
items.sentZh: 我的卧室不大，但干净舒适。

items.sent: There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf in it.
items.sentZh: 房间里有一张床、一张书桌和一个书架。

items.sent: On the desk there is a lamp and my computer.
items.sentZh: 桌上有台灯和电脑。

items.sent: I do my homework and read books there every evening.
items.sentZh: 每天晚上我都在那里写作业、读书。

items.sent: Above the bed hangs a picture of the sea.
items.sentZh: 床的上方挂着一幅大海的画。

items.sent: I put all my books and toys in order, so I can find them easily.
items.sentZh: 我把所有的书和玩具摆放整齐，找起来很方便。

items.sent: I clean my room myself every week.
items.sentZh: 我每周自己打扫房间。

items.sent: I love my own little world.
items.sentZh: 我爱我的小天地。

items.sent: English is not easy, but I have some useful ways to learn it well.
items.sentZh: 英语并不容易，但我有一些学好它的好方法。

items.sent: First, I listen to the tape and read aloud every morning.
items.sentZh: 第一，每天早晨听录音、大声朗读；

items.sent: Second, I keep a diary in English to practise writing.
items.sentZh: 第二，坚持用英语写日记来练习写作；

items.sent: Third, when I meet new words, I look them up in a dictionary instead of giving up.
items.sentZh: 第三，遇到生词就查词典，而不是放弃。

items.sent: Watching English cartoons is also helpful.
items.sentZh: 看英文动画片也很有帮助。

items.sent: Little by little, my English is getting better.
items.sentZh: 渐渐地，我的英语越来越好。

items.sent: Remember: where there is a will, there is a way.
items.sentZh: 记住：有志者事竟成。

items.sent: One evening, an old man fell down suddenly on our bus.
items.sentZh: 一天晚上，一位老人在我们乘坐的公交车上突然摔倒。

items.sent: The driver stopped the bus right away and asked if he was all right.
items.sentZh: 司机立刻停车，询问他是否还好，

items.sent: Then he drove the old man to the nearest hospital as fast as possible without thinking twice.
items.sentZh: 然后毫不犹豫地以最快的速度把老人送到了最近的医院。

items.sent: Luckily, the doctor said the old man was fine.
items.sentZh: 幸运的是，医生说老人没有大碍。

items.sent: All the passengers praised the driver.
items.sentZh: 全体乘客都称赞这位司机。

items.sent: From him I learned that kindness and a warm heart can light up the world.
items.sentZh: 从他身上我明白：善良和热心能照亮世界。

items.sent: The Dragon Boat Festival is on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
items.sentZh: 端午节在农历五月初五，

items.sent: It has a history of more than two thousand years.
items.sentZh: 已有两千多年的历史。

items.sent: On that day, people eat zongzi, a kind of traditional food made of rice, and hold exciting dragon boat races on the river.
items.sentZh: 那一天，人们吃粽子——一种用米做的传统食物，还在河上举行激动人心的龙舟比赛。

items.sent: The festival is in memory of Qu Yuan, a great poet who loved his country deeply.
items.sentZh: 这个节日是为了纪念深爱祖国的伟大诗人屈原。

items.sent: Every year I watch the races on TV with my family.
items.sentZh: 每年我都和家人一起在电视上看龙舟赛。

items.sent: Water is important for all living things, but many places in the world are short of water.
items.sentZh: 水对所有生物都很重要，但世界上许多地方缺水。

items.sent: We must save every drop.
items.sentZh: 我们必须节约每一滴水。

items.sent: At home, we should turn off the tap after washing hands and reuse water to clean the floor or water the flowers.
items.sentZh: 在家，洗完手要关紧水龙头，用过的水可以拖地或浇花；

items.sent: At school, we should report broken taps in time.
items.sentZh: 在学校，发现水龙头坏了要及时报告。

items.sent: Remember: never throw rubbish into rivers or lakes.
items.sentZh: 记住：千万不要往河流湖泊里扔垃圾。

items.sent: If everyone saves a little water every day, our world will be much better.
items.sentZh: 如果人人每天节约一点水，我们的世界会更美好。

items.sent: My grandpa has a small garden behind his house.
items.sentZh: 爷爷在房后有一个小菜园，

items.sent: He grows tomatoes, potatoes, cabbages and all kinds of flowers there.
items.sentZh: 里面种着西红柿、土豆、卷心菜和各种花。

items.sent: Every morning he gets up early, waters the plants and pulls out the grass.
items.sentZh: 每天清晨他早早起床，给植物浇水、拔草。

items.sent: In autumn, he often sends us fresh vegetables.
items.sentZh: 秋天，他常给我们送来新鲜蔬菜。

items.sent: Grandpa says plants are like children: if you look after them carefully, they will give you surprises.
items.sentZh: 爷爷说，植物就像孩子：细心照料，它们就会给你惊喜。

items.sent: Working in the garden keeps him healthy and happy.
items.sentZh: 打理菜园让他健康又快乐。

items.sent: Last term, I forgot to do my maths homework and copied my deskmate's answers.
items.sentZh: 上学期，我忘了做数学作业，抄了同桌的答案。

items.sent: My teacher found it out, but she didn't shout at me.
items.sentZh: 老师发现了，但她没有吼我，

items.sent: She asked me to stay after class and told me a story about honesty.
items.sentZh: 而是让我课后留下，给我讲了一个关于诚实的故事。

items.sent: Her words touched my heart deeply.
items.sentZh: 她的话深深打动了我。

items.sent: I said sorry and promised never to cheat again.
items.sentZh: 我道了歉，保证再也不作弊。

items.sent: From then on, I always finish my homework by myself.
items.sentZh: 从那以后，我总是独立完成作业。

items.sent: This lesson taught me to be an honest person.
items.sentZh: 这一课教会我做一个诚实的人。

items.sent: Here is the weather report for tomorrow.
items.sentZh: 下面是明天的天气预报。

items.sent: It will be sunny in the morning in most areas, so it is a good time for outdoor activities.
items.sentZh: 上午大部分地区晴，适合户外活动。

items.sent: In the afternoon, clouds will appear and there will be a light rain in the south.
items.sentZh: 下午多云，南部有小雨。

items.sent: The temperature will drop to ten degrees at night, so please wear warm clothes.
items.sentZh: 夜间气温将降到十度，请注意保暖。

items.sent: People in the northern mountains should be careful, because the wind may be quite strong.
items.sentZh: 北部山区风力可能较大，请当心。

items.sent: Thank you for listening.
items.sentZh: 感谢收听。

items.sent: Yesterday I had a bad headache and a sore throat, so my mother took me to the hospital.
items.sentZh: 昨天我头疼得厉害，嗓子也疼，妈妈带我去了医院。

items.sent: The doctor asked me some questions and took my temperature.
items.sentZh: 医生问了一些问题，量了体温，

items.sent: He said I had caught a bad cold and gave me some medicine.
items.sentZh: 说我得了重感冒，开了些药，

items.sent: He told me to take the medicine three times a day, drink more warm water and rest in bed.
items.sentZh: 叮嘱我一天服三次药、多喝温水、卧床休息。

items.sent: Now I feel much better.
items.sentZh: 现在我好多了。

items.sent: I will do more exercise to keep fit.
items.sentZh: 我要多锻炼，保持健康。

items.sent: During the summer holidays, my cousin Jack came to China from Canada.
items.sentZh: 暑假里，表哥杰克从加拿大来到中国。

items.sent: It was his first time in Beijing, so we took him to the Great Wall, the Palace Museum and some beautiful parks.
items.sentZh: 这是他第一次到北京，我们带他去了长城、故宫和一些美丽的公园。

items.sent: He was amazed at everything and took hundreds of photos.
items.sentZh: 他对一切都惊叹不已，拍了几百张照片。

items.sent: At first he couldn't use chopsticks, but now he can pick up dumplings!
items.sentZh: 起初他不会用筷子，现在居然能夹起饺子了！

items.sent: He taught me English, and I taught him Chinese.
items.sentZh: 他教我英语，我教他中文。

items.sent: We had a great time together.
items.sentZh: 我们一起度过了美好的时光。

items.sent: Our school sports meeting was held last Thursday.
items.sentZh: 上周四我们学校举行了运动会。

items.sent: Hundreds of students took part in different events, such as running, high jump and long jump.
items.sentZh: 数百名学生参加了跑步、跳高、跳远等不同项目。

items.sent: I joined the 800-metre race.
items.sentZh: 我参加了800米赛跑。

items.sent: At first I ran fast, but in the middle I felt tired and wanted to stop.
items.sentZh: 起初我跑得很快，但中途感到疲惫，想停下来。

items.sent: My classmates shouted loudly to cheer me on.
items.sentZh: 同学们大声为我加油，

items.sent: Their voices gave me strength.
items.sentZh: 他们的喊声给了我力量。

items.sent: In the end I got second place.
items.sentZh: 最后我获得了第二名。

items.sent: I understood that never giving up is the key to success.
items.sentZh: 我明白了：永不放弃是成功的关键。

items.sent: Some people think reading paper books is out of date because the Internet is fast and easy.
items.sentZh: 有人认为读纸质书已经过时，因为网络快捷方便。

items.sent: However, I don't fully agree.
items.sentZh: 但我不完全同意。

items.sent: The Internet is good for finding news quickly, but reading books helps us think deeply and quietly.
items.sentZh: 网络适合快速查找新闻，而读书能让我们深入而安静地思考。

items.sent: A paper book does not need electricity, and it protects our eyes better than screens.
items.sentZh: 纸质书不需要电，比屏幕更护眼。

items.sent: My way is to use both: search online, then read books carefully.
items.sentZh: 我的方法是两者都用：先上网搜索，再仔细读书。

items.sent: In this way, we can enjoy the advantages of both worlds.
items.sentZh: 这样就能同时享受两个世界的优点。

items.sent: Last Sunday the weather was fine, so our class had a picnic in People's Park.
items.sentZh: 上周日天气晴好，我们班在人民公园野餐。

items.sent: We rode there by bike.
items.sentZh: 我们骑自行车过去。

items.sent: Some students put up the tent, some carried water, and others prepared food.
items.sentZh: 有的同学搭帐篷，有的提水，其他人准备食物。

items.sent: We brought bread, sandwiches, fruit and juice.
items.sentZh: 我们带了面包、三明治、水果和果汁。

items.sent: After lunch, we played games, sang songs and flew kites on the grass.
items.sentZh: 午饭后，我们在草地上做游戏、唱歌、放风筝。

items.sent: Before leaving, we picked up all the rubbish and kept the park clean.
items.sentZh: 离开前，我们捡起所有垃圾，保持公园整洁。

items.sent: Everyone enjoyed the happy day in nature.
items.sentZh: 大家都享受了大自然中快乐的一天。

items.sent: Life in the city and the country is quite different.
items.sentZh: 城市和乡村的生活大不相同。

items.sent: Cities are big and modern, with tall buildings, busy streets and large supermarkets.
items.sentZh: 城市宏大而现代，有高楼、繁忙的街道和大超市，

items.sent: It is easy to study and shop there, but the air is sometimes dirty and life is noisy.
items.sentZh: 在那里学习和购物都很方便，但空气有时污浊，生活喧闹。

items.sent: In the country, the air is fresh, the mountains are green and people live quietly.
items.sentZh: 乡村空气清新、山峦翠绿、生活宁静，

items.sent: Many city people like to spend their holidays in villages.
items.sentZh: 许多城里人喜欢去村里度假。

items.sent: I enjoy both, because each has its own beauty.
items.sentZh: 两种生活我都喜欢，因为各有各的美。

items.sent: Of all my subjects, I like science best.
items.sentZh: 在所有学科中，我最喜欢科学。

items.sent: It opens my eyes to the amazing world.
items.sentZh: 它让我看到世界的奇妙。

items.sent: In class, we do interesting experiments and find out how things work.
items.sentZh: 课堂上，我们做有趣的实验，弄清事物运行的原理。

items.sent: Once our teacher showed us how to make a small model plane, and it really flew!
items.sentZh: 有一次老师教我们做小飞机模型，它真的飞起来了！

items.sent: Science is sometimes difficult, but when I solve a problem, I feel really excited.
items.sentZh: 科学有时很难，但每当我解开一道难题，就特别兴奋。

items.sent: I hope to become a scientist and invent useful things for people in the future.
items.sentZh: 我希望将来成为科学家，为人们发明有用的东西。

items.sent: A smile may be small, but its power is great.
items.sentZh: 微笑虽小，力量却很大。

items.sent: When you meet your teachers and friends in the morning, a sweet smile says hello better than words.
items.sentZh: 早晨见到老师和朋友时，一个甜甜的微笑比言语更好地表达问候；

items.sent: When your classmates feel nervous or fail an exam, your smile gives them warmth and courage.
items.sentZh: 当同学紧张或考试失利时，你的微笑给他们温暖和勇气。

items.sent: Smiling can also make strangers become friends quickly.
items.sentZh: 微笑还能让陌生人很快变成朋友。

items.sent: It costs nothing but brings light to others.
items.sentZh: 它分文不花，却给别人带去光亮。

items.sent: So let's smile at life every day, even when times are hard.
items.sentZh: 所以，即使日子艰难，也让我们每天微笑面对生活。

items.sent: One evening after school, I found a wallet on the ground near the school gate.
items.sentZh: 一天傍晚放学后，我在校门口的地上捡到一个钱包，

items.sent: There was much money and an ID card in it.
items.sentZh: 里面有很多钱和一张身份证。

items.sent: I thought the owner must be very worried.
items.sentZh: 我想失主一定很着急，

items.sent: So I waited there and asked my teacher for help.
items.sentZh: 于是在原地等候，并请老师帮忙。

items.sent: Through the information on the card, we soon found the owner, a young man.
items.sentZh: 通过卡片上的信息，我们很快找到了失主——一位年轻人。

items.sent: He was so thankful that he wanted to give me money, but I refused.
items.sentZh: 他非常感激，想给我钱作为酬谢，我谢绝了。

items.sent: Being honest made me feel proud and happy.
items.sentZh: 诚实让我感到自豪和快乐。

items.sent: Many students love playing computer games.
items.sentZh: 许多学生爱玩电脑游戏。

items.sent: In some ways, games can help us relax and even train our brains and reactions.
items.sentZh: 从某些方面说，游戏能帮助我们放松，甚至锻炼大脑和反应能力。

items.sent: However, if we spend too much time playing, our eyesight may get worse and our grades will drop.
items.sentZh: 然而，如果玩的时间太长，视力会下降，成绩也会滑坡。

items.sent: Some children even lie to their parents about games.
items.sentZh: 有些孩子甚至为了游戏对父母撒谎。

items.sent: In my opinion, we can play games for a short time at weekends, but study and health must come first.
items.sentZh: 依我看，周末可以适当玩一会儿，但学习和健康必须放在首位。

items.sent: Learning to control ourselves is the most important.
items.sentZh: 学会自我控制才是最重要的。

items.sent: Last weekend my little sister and I visited the city zoo.
items.sentZh: 上周末，我和妹妹参观了市动物园。

items.sent: We saw many animals: strong lions, tall giraffes, playful monkeys and fat pandas eating bamboo.
items.sentZh: 我们看到了许多动物：威武的狮子、高大的长颈鹿、顽皮的猴子，还有正吃竹子的胖熊猫。

items.sent: The pandas were the most popular; everyone loved their funny actions.
items.sentZh: 熊猫最受欢迎，人人都喜欢它们憨态可掬的样子。

items.sent: My sister was afraid of the huge elephants at first, but later she fed them apples.
items.sentZh: 妹妹起初害怕巨大的大象，后来还喂它们苹果呢。

items.sent: At the bird house, we enjoyed the colourful parrots talking.
items.sentZh: 在鸟馆，我们欣赏了会说话的彩色鹦鹉。

items.sent: Animals are our friends, and we should protect them instead of hurting them.
items.sentZh: 动物是我们的朋友，我们应该保护而不是伤害它们。

items.sent: Mother's Day falls on the second Sunday of May.
items.sentZh: 母亲节是五月的第二个星期日。

items.sent: This year I decided to do something special for my mother.
items.sentZh: 今年我决定为妈妈做点特别的事。

items.sent: In the morning I got up early and cooked breakfast for her.
items.sentZh: 早晨我早早起床为她做早餐，

items.sent: Then I cleaned the house and washed the dishes.
items.sentZh: 然后打扫房间、洗碗。

items.sent: I also made a beautiful card with my own hands and wrote: Thank you, Mum, I love you.
items.sentZh: 我还亲手做了一张漂亮的卡片，写下：谢谢您，妈妈，我爱您。

items.sent: When she read the words, tears came into her eyes.
items.sentZh: 当她读到这些话时，眼里噙满泪水。

items.sent: Helping parents makes us grow.
items.sentZh: 为父母分忧让我们成长。

items.sent: My home is not far from the school, so I walk there every day.
items.sentZh: 我家离学校不远，所以我每天步行上学，

items.sent: It takes about fifteen minutes.
items.sentZh: 大约需要十五分钟。

items.sent: On my way, I pass a small river, a bakery and a busy street.
items.sentZh: 路上要经过一条小河、一家面包店和一条热闹的街道。

items.sent: In spring, flowers come out along the river, and birds sing in the trees.
items.sentZh: 春天，河边鲜花开放，鸟儿在树上歌唱。

items.sent: Walking not only keeps me healthy but also helps me wake up fully.
items.sentZh: 步行不仅让我保持健康，还帮我完全清醒。

items.sent: Besides, walking causes no pollution, so it is friendly to our environment.
items.sentZh: 而且，步行没有污染，对环境友好。

items.sent: At night, the sky is like a huge black curtain covered with shining diamonds.
items.sentZh: 夜晚，天空像一块缀满闪亮钻石的巨大黑色幕布。

items.sent: The moon is the brightest of them all.
items.sentZh: 月亮是其中最亮的。

items.sent: It changes its shape every week, from a thin sickle to a round plate.
items.sentZh: 它每周变换形状，从细细的月牙变成圆圆的玉盘。

items.sent: Long ago, people told many beautiful stories about the moon.
items.sentZh: 很久以前，人们讲过许多关于月亮的美丽故事；

items.sent: Today scientists have even walked on it.
items.sentZh: 今天，科学家们甚至已经在月球上行走过。

items.sent: When I feel lonely, I look up at the stars, and they quietly keep me company like old friends.
items.sentZh: 当我感到孤独时，就抬头望星星，它们像老朋友一样静静地陪伴着我。

items.sent: There are forty-five students in my class, and each of them is special.
items.sentZh: 我们班有四十五名学生，每个人都有自己的特点。

items.sent: Li Hua is the tallest and plays basketball best.
items.sentZh: 李华个子最高，篮球打得最好；

items.sent: Wang Fang draws wonderful pictures and wants to be an artist.
items.sentZh: 王芳画画出色，想当画家；

items.sent: Tom is humorous and always tells jokes that make us laugh.
items.sentZh: 汤姆很幽默，总讲笑话逗我们笑；

items.sent: Our monitor is serious and responsible; she helps the teacher manage the class well.
items.sentZh: 班长认真负责，帮老师把班级管理得井井有条。

items.sent: We may be different, but we help each other like a big family.
items.sentZh: 我们各不相同，却像一个大家庭一样互相帮助。

items.sent: I love my classmates.
items.sentZh: 我爱我的同学们。

items.sent: Animals are humans' friends, but many of them are in danger now.
items.sentZh: 动物是人类的朋友，但如今许多动物正濒临危险。

items.sent: Some people kill animals for their fur or meat, and some cut down forests, so animals lose their homes.
items.sentZh: 有人为了毛皮或肉而捕杀动物，有人砍伐森林，使动物失去家园。

items.sent: If this goes on, we will never see tigers, elephants or some birds again.
items.sentZh: 这样下去，我们将再也见不到老虎、大象和一些鸟类。

items.sent: To protect animals, we should say no to fur clothes and protect the environment.
items.sentZh: 为了保护动物，我们应该对皮草制品说不，并保护环境。

items.sent: It is everyone's duty to keep the balance of nature.
items.sentZh: 维持自然平衡是每个人的责任。

items.sent: Let's act now!
items.sentZh: 让我们行动起来吧！

items.sent: When I woke up this morning, the world outside was completely white.
items.sentZh: 今天早晨醒来时，外面的世界一片洁白——

items.sent: It had snowed all night!
items.sentZh: 下了一整夜的雪！

items.sent: This was the first snow of the winter.
items.sentZh: 这是今冬的第一场雪。

items.sent: I hurried through breakfast and ran outside.
items.sentZh: 我匆匆吃完早饭就跑了出去。

items.sent: The snow was deep and soft, and my shoes left little holes on it.
items.sentZh: 雪又深又软，我的鞋在上面留下一个个小坑。

items.sent: My friends and I had a big snowball fight and made a snowman with a carrot nose.
items.sentZh: 我和朋友们打了一场大大的雪仗，还堆了一个插着胡萝卜鼻子的雪人。

items.sent: Though my hands were freezing, nothing could stop our laughter.
items.sentZh: 虽然手都冻僵了，但没有什么能挡住我们的笑声。

items.sent: On New Year's Eve, the whole family got together to make dumplings.
items.sentZh: 除夕夜，全家人聚在一起包饺子。

items.sent: Grandma prepared the dough, and Mum mixed the meat with cabbage to make the filling.
items.sentZh: 奶奶和面，妈妈把肉和白菜拌成馅。

items.sent: I learned to put the filling in the middle of the wrapper and press the edges together.
items.sentZh: 我学着把馅放在饺子皮中间，再把边缘捏紧。

items.sent: My first dumplings looked strange, but they got better and better.
items.sentZh: 我最初的几个饺子样子怪怪的，但越包越好。

items.sent: Grandpa hid a coin in one dumpling for good luck.
items.sentZh: 爷爷还在一个饺子里藏了硬币图个吉利。

items.sent: Cooking with family is full of warmth and laughter.
items.sentZh: 和家人一起做饭，充满了温暖和欢笑。

items.sent: Every Saturday evening, I call my grandma, who lives alone in her hometown far away.
items.sentZh: 每个星期六晚上，我都给独自住在远方老家的奶奶打电话。

items.sent: I tell her about my school life and my little brother.
items.sentZh: 我给她讲我的学校生活和弟弟的趣事。

items.sent: She always listens carefully and laughs at my funny stories.
items.sentZh: 她总是认真听，被我逗得直笑，

items.sent: Sometimes she teaches me old songs on the phone.
items.sentZh: 有时还在电话里教我唱老歌。

items.sent: Grandma says my voice makes her day.
items.sentZh: 奶奶说，我的声音让她一天都开心。

items.sent: Although we cannot see each other often, the telephone line carries our love across hundreds of kilometres.
items.sentZh: 虽然我们不能常见面，但电话线把我们的爱传过千山万水。

items.sent: This weekend is going to be busy but interesting.
items.sentZh: 这个周末会既忙碌又有趣。

items.sent: On Saturday morning, I will finish my homework first.
items.sentZh: 周六上午我先完成作业，

items.sent: In the afternoon, I am going to play football with my friends.
items.sentZh: 下午和朋友们踢足球。

items.sent: On Sunday morning, I will visit the science museum with my father and watch a 3D film about dinosaurs.
items.sentZh: 周日上午和爸爸去参观科技馆，看一部关于恐龙的3D电影；

items.sent: In the afternoon, I plan to help Mum clean the house and cook a simple dinner.
items.sentZh: 下午我打算帮妈妈打扫房间、做一顿简单的晚饭。

items.sent: A good plan makes life full and free of rush.
items.sentZh: 好的计划让生活充实而不慌乱。

items.sent: Traffic rules are made to keep everyone safe, so we must follow them.
items.sentZh: 交通规则是为了保障每个人的安全而制定的，所以我们必须遵守。

items.sent: When the light is red, stop and wait; when it turns green, we can go.
items.sentZh: 红灯停，绿灯行。

items.sent: We should walk on the pavement and cross the road at the zebra crossing.
items.sentZh: 走路要走人行道，过马路要走斑马线。

items.sent: Never play or chase each other on the road, and don't ride too fast.
items.sentZh: 不要在道路上玩耍追逐，骑车不要太快。

items.sent: At the same time, drivers mustn't drive after drinking.
items.sentZh: 同时，司机绝不能酒后驾车。

items.sent: Safety comes first, for ourselves and for others.
items.sentZh: 无论为了自己还是他人，安全永远第一。

items.sent: Music is a wonderful gift in our life.
items.sentZh: 音乐是生活中一份美妙的礼物。

items.sent: When I am tired, soft music helps me relax; when I am sad, an exciting song gives me power.
items.sentZh: 疲惫时，轻柔的音乐让我放松；难过时，一首激昂的歌曲给我力量。

items.sent: I started learning the violin at the age of six.
items.sentZh: 我六岁开始学小提琴。

items.sent: Practising is sometimes boring and my fingers hurt, but I never want to give up.
items.sentZh: 练琴有时很枯燥，手指也会疼，但我从不想放弃。

items.sent: Last month I performed on stage for the first time, and the audience clapped warmly.
items.sentZh: 上个月我第一次登台演出，观众报以热烈的掌声。

items.sent: Music makes my life colourful.
items.sentZh: 音乐让我的生活丰富多彩。

items.sent: Growing up is like climbing a mountain.
items.sentZh: 成长就像爬山。

items.sent: When I was a small child, my parents did everything for me.
items.sentZh: 小时候，父母为我打理一切。

items.sent: Now I am a middle school student, and I am learning to do things on my own: washing clothes, cooking simple dishes and making decisions.
items.sentZh: 现在我是中学生了，正学着自己的事情自己做：洗衣服、做简单的饭菜、自己做决定。

items.sent: Sometimes I make mistakes, but mistakes teach me lessons.
items.sentZh: 有时会犯错，但错误给我教训。

items.sent: Growing up also means caring about others, not only myself.
items.sentZh: 成长也意味着关心他人，而不只是自己。

items.sent: I know the road is long, but every step makes me stronger.
items.sentZh: 我知道路还很长，但每一步都让我更强大。

items.sent: Dear Lucy, how are you?
items.sentZh: 亲爱的露茜：你好吗？

items.sent: Thank you for your last email and the photos of your school in London.
items.sentZh: 谢谢你的上一封邮件和伦敦学校的照片，

items.sent: They are really amazing.
items.sentZh: 真是太棒了。

items.sent: I'd like to tell you about my school life in China.
items.sentZh: 我想讲讲我在中国的学校生活。

items.sent: We start school at eight and have seven lessons a day.
items.sentZh: 我们八点开始上课，每天七节课。

items.sent: My favourite subject is English.
items.sentZh: 我最喜欢的科目是英语。

items.sent: After class, I often play table tennis with my friends.
items.sentZh: 课后我常和朋友们打乒乓球。

items.sent: Please write back and tell me about your hobbies.
items.sentZh: 请回信告诉我你的爱好。

items.sent: Best wishes, Li Hua.
items.sentZh: 祝好，李华。

items.sent: Yesterday I found an old photo album in the drawer.
items.sentZh: 昨天我在抽屉里发现一本旧相册。

items.sent: In the photos, my parents were young and thin, and I was a little baby in Mum's arms.
items.sentZh: 照片里，爸爸妈妈年轻清瘦，我还是妈妈怀里的小婴儿。

items.sent: There were also pictures of our old small house and my father's first motorbike.
items.sentZh: 还有我们从前的小屋和爸爸第一辆摩托车的照片。

items.sent: Time flies, and so many things have changed.
items.sentZh: 时光飞逝，一切都变了这么多。

items.sent: Mum said every photo is a piece of memory.
items.sentZh: 妈妈说，每张照片都是一段记忆。

items.sent: I will keep the album well, because it records our family's love and story.
items.sentZh: 我要好好保存这本相册，因为它记录着我们家的爱和故事。

items.sent: Thomas Edison failed more than a thousand times before he invented the light bulb.
items.sentZh: 爱迪生发明电灯前失败了一千多次。

items.sent: When he was young, his teachers thought he was not clever, but he never stopped trying.
items.sentZh: 小时候，老师们都认为他不够聪明，但他从未停止尝试。

items.sent: His story tells us a simple truth: never give up.
items.sentZh: 他的故事告诉我们一个朴素的道理：永不放弃。

items.sent: In our study and life, we all meet difficulties.
items.sentZh: 在学习和生活中，我们都会遇到困难。

items.sent: Instead of crying or running away, we should face them bravely and try one more time.
items.sentZh: 与其哭泣或逃避，不如勇敢面对、再试一次。

items.sent: Remember, winners are just those who stand up one more time after falling.
items.sentZh: 记住：成功者不过是跌倒后再多站起来一次的人。
